featurePotion.Name: Enable healing potion configurator
featurePotion.Hint: GM-only explicit-tag configurator with preview and restore.

featureHpGamble.Name: Enable hit-point gamble
featureHpGamble.Hint: GM-only native Hit Points Advancement helper; level 1 is untouched.

featureLowAbility.Name: Enable low-ability reminders
featureLowAbility.Hint: Contextual warning only; never changes Actor data.

featureAmmo.Name: Enable ammunition tier ledger
featureAmmo.Hint: Records explicit tagged ammunition after native consumption; recovery remains GM-confirmed.

featureStealth.Name: Enable explicit stealth helper
featureStealth.Hint: Warning/suggestion helper; never rolls back token movement.

featureNaturalOne.Name: Natural 1: create GM consequence cards
featureNaturalOne.Hint: When an attack retains a natural 1, create a GM-only confirmation card; no damage, counterattack, or weapon penalty occurs before confirmation.

featureNaturalTwenty.Name: Natural 20: count the first damage die as maximum
featureNaturalTwenty.Hint: Applies to weapon and spell attacks; all critical dice are still rolled, the first die of the primary damage part counts as maximum, and other damage parts retain native critical handling.

lowAbilityThreshold.Name: Low ability reminder threshold
lowAbilityThreshold.Hint: Warn only when a selected character is at or below this score.

consequenceMultiplier.Name: Natural-1 consequence damage multiplier
consequenceMultiplier.Hint: Choose 0.5 or 1; native dnd5e damage application retains resistance and immunity.

consequenceOtherTable.Name: Natural-1 other RollTable UUID
consequenceOtherTable.Hint: Optional exact RollTable UUID, used only after GM confirmation.

stealthRogueLevel.Name: Stealth full-speed rogue level
stealthRogueLevel.Hint: Rogue total level at which explicit stealth is unrestricted.
